container_info.description:
The project aims to develop a **Commercial Energy Consumption Analytics & Anomaly Alerts** system that provides an intelligent monitoring layer for large commercial energy customers.

It uses interval meter data to surface consumption trends, benchmark against comparable sites, and generate alerts for significant deviations in usage.

This addresses the lack of customer-facing analytics and tools for account managers, helping reduce energy waste and improve customer retention.

steps.name: disable-broken-profiled
steps.description: Detect and safely disable a corrupt /etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh that breaks non-interactive shells. Move it to a timestamped .disabled backup if it matches error signatures. This is required so subsequent scripts using /usr/bin/env bash run reliably.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/dt3_bootcamp_backend/FastAPIBackendAPI"
FILE=/etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh
if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  if sudo grep -E "npm: command not found|export: `command:|To: command not found" "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    TS=$(date +%s)
    sudo mv "$FILE" "$FILE.disabled.$TS"
  fi
fi
exit 0

output_scripts.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/dt3_bootcamp_backend/FastAPIBackendAPI"
FILE=/etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh
# Read file via sudo cat and search locally to avoid sourcing /etc/profile.d or invoking shells that load it
if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  if sudo /bin/cat "$FILE" | /bin/grep -E -q 'npm: command not found|export: `command:|To: command not found'; then
    TS=$(date +%s)
    sudo /bin/mv "$FILE" "$FILE.disabled.$TS"
  fi
fi
exit 0

steps.summary: Created and executed a safe, idempotent script to detect and disable a corrupt /etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh that breaks non-interactive shells. Initial direct execution encountered failures because the broken profile was being sourced and contained malformed backticks causing shells to fail. I implemented a robust approach that reads the file contents via sudo cat and uses local grep (no backtick interpolation) and absolute binary paths to avoid sourcing the profile or invoking shells that load it. The resulting script moves the file to /etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh.disabled.<timestamp> when signature strings are found, otherwise it leaves the file in place. The script is written to .init/install.sh and follows the required script structure and idempotency rules.

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Start uvicorn from the workspace venv, ensure port 8000 is free or fail fast, write logs to a mktemp file, probe the root endpoint with retries, then stop the server cleanly and emit evidence. Verifies build/run/test lifecycle.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/dt3_bootcamp_backend/FastAPIBackendAPI"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
source "$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/activate"
PORT=8000
if ss -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -qE ":${PORT}$|:${PORT}\b"; then
  echo "validation: port ${PORT} appears in use" >&2
  exit 3
fi
LOG=$(mktemp /tmp/fastapi.XXXXXX.log)
"$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/uvicorn" main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
trap 'kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
OK=1
for i in {1..20}; do
  if curl --silent --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/ | grep -q '"status":"ok"'; then OK=0; break; fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ $OK -eq 0 ]; then
  kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$LOG" || true; echo "validation: ok"; exit 0
else
  echo "validation: failed - no expected response" >&2; echo "--- server log (head) ---" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 2
fi
